name: (Ulgrem-Axaan) Befouling Odor

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

text: 15 feet. Creatures entering or starting their turn in the emanation must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude save save or be Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure). A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune to befouling odor for 1 minute.
